readings: Use fee records with feerate strictly greater than 0.0009. Join each fee to an order where fees.orderslink exactly equals orders.recordvault, and discard unmatched fees. For each orderslink and dealedge combination, calculate AVG(feerate - rebrate), excluding rows where either value is missing, and count all qualifying joined fee records. For each side, take the unweighted average of its group averages. Return groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than that side average. Show orderslink, side, group average net fee rate, record count, and group average minus side average. Sort by the difference descending, with missing values last; return the first 10 without rounding.

Use fee records with feerate greater than or equal to 0.0009. Join each fee to an order where fees.orderslink exactly equals orders.recordvault, and discard unmatched fees. For each orderslink and dealedge combination, calculate AVG(feerate - rebrate), excluding rows where either value is missing, and count all qualifying joined fee records. For each side, take the unweighted average of its group averages. Return groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than that side average. Show orderslink, side, group average net fee rate, record count, and group average minus side average. Sort by the difference descending, with missing values last; return the first 10 without rounding.
queries:
WITH fee_groups AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge AS side,
        AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS group_average_net_fee_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
    SELECT side, AVG(group_average_net_fee_rate) AS side_average
    FROM fee_groups
    GROUP BY side
)
SELECT
    g.orderslink,
    g.side,
    g.group_average_net_fee_rate,
    g.record_count,
    g.group_average_net_fee_rate - s.side_average AS difference
FROM fee_groups AS g
JOIN side_averages AS s
    ON g.side IS s.side
WHERE g.group_average_net_fee_rate > s.side_average
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH fee_groups AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge AS side,
        AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS group_average_net_fee_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
    SELECT
        side,
        AVG(group_average_net_fee_rate) AS side_average
    FROM fee_groups
    GROUP BY side
)
SELECT
    g.orderslink,
    g.side,
    g.group_average_net_fee_rate,
    g.record_count,
    g.group_average_net_fee_rate - s.side_average AS difference
FROM fee_groups AS g
JOIN side_averages AS s
    ON g.side IS s.side
WHERE g.group_average_net_fee_rate > s.side_average
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10
